page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 virtual instance within the ecs.s3 server family, operating on a KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of memory, yielding a memory allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU core. It contains no integrated GPU hardware accelerators and features no local storage, relying on external network-attached storage for persistent disk needs. The instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses upon provisioning.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio prioritizes processor core density over memory capacity, making it a compute-oriented allocation model. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent core processing performance without contention from hypervisor thread sharing. Because local storage is absent, data throughput is bounded by network storage performance. This instance configuration provides cost efficiency for stateless compute tasks, batch workloads, light microservices, and container worker nodes that rely on centralized remote block volumes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is a compute-oriented x86_64 virtual server instance running on KVM hypervisors. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of RAM, offering a resource ratio of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no bundled local storage and no GPU accelerators, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data requirements. Public network interfaces do not include complimentary IPv4 addressing. The 1:2 CPU-to-memory allocation and dedicated virtual CPU delivery ensure steady core execution without resource competition from co-located instances. The lack of local disks reduces instance overhead for stateless architectures. Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is suitable for stateless web services, batch processing, application worker nodes, and microservice deployments.
